avoid_supplements.name: High-dose Vitamin K supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potential antagonism of antibiotic efficacy; theoretical interference with bacterial cell wall disruption
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid supplementation exceeding dietary sources; maintain consistent dietary vitamin K intake

avoid_supplements.name: Probiotics (during acute therapy)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May reduce daptomycin efficacy by competing with pathogenic organisms; disrupts intended antimicrobial action
avoid_supplements.action: Separate probiotic administration by at least 2 hours from daptomycin dosing; consider delaying probiotics until post-treatment

caution_supplements.name: HMG-CoA reductase inhibitors (statins as supplements)
caution_supplements.mechanism: Concurrent use may increase risk of muscle toxicity and myopathy; daptomycin has known muscle-related adverse effects
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for muscle pain, weakness, or elevated CK levels; coordinate with prescriber regarding statin continuation

caution_supplements.name: Magnesium supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: Daptomycin requires calcium/magnesium for optimal activity; excessive supplementation may cause electrolyte imbalance
caution_supplements.action: Maintain normal dietary magnesium; monitor serum electrolytes if supplementing

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: While daptomycin is not CYP3A4-metabolized, grapefruit may affect renal function and electrolyte balance
avoid_foods.action: Avoid excessive grapefruit consumption during therapy

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May delay gastric emptying and affect IV administration timing; minimal direct interaction as daptomycin is IV-only
caution_foods.action: No specific restriction; maintain normal nutrition to support immune function during infection treatment

caution_foods.name: Foods high in potassium
caution_foods.mechanism: Daptomycin can affect electrolyte balance; excessive potassium intake may potentiate imbalances
caution_foods.action: Maintain normal dietary potassium; monitor serum electrolytes during treatment

monitoring_notes: Daptomycin has minimal drug-supplement interactions due to non-hepatic metabolism and IV administration. Primary concerns are electrolyte monitoring (calcium, magnesium, potassium) and muscle toxicity risk (CK levels, myalgia). Renal function assessment is essential given renal elimination.
